description: Updates an existing note in Salesforce with the specified changes. Only provided fields will be updated.

body.description: Updated body/content of the note. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
examples: Updated: Customer confirmed interest in premium plan. Sending contract next week.
Update: Customer called back and scheduled demo for Friday.
body.human_parameter_description: The new content of the note. Leave blank to keep the existing text.
body.title: Body

custom_fields.description: Custom fields to update on the note. Keys should be the API names of custom fields (e.g., 'Custom_Field__c'). Values can be strings, numbers, booleans, or null.
custom_fields.human_parameter_description: A dictionary of custom field API names and their values to update. Use the field's API name (ending in __c) as the key.
custom_fields.title: Custom Fields

is_private.description: Updated privacy setting. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
is_private.human_parameter_description: Choose whether the note should be private (visible only to the owner) or shared. Leave empty to keep the current setting.
is_private.title: Is Private

note_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the note to update.
note_id.human_parameter_description: The unique Salesforce ID of the note you want to update. You can copy it from the note's URL or from a previous search or list step.
note_id.title: Note Id

owner_id.description: Updated owner ID. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
owner_id.human_parameter_description: The Salesforce User ID of the person who should own the note after the update. Leave blank to keep the current owner.
owner_id.title: Owner Id

title.description: Updated title of the note. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
title.human_parameter_description: The new title for the note. Leave blank to keep the current title.
title.title: Title

name: update_note

UpdateNoteResponse.description:
Response for successful note update.

HTTP 204 No Content - Salesforce returns empty body on successful update.
Error responses (4xx/5xx) are handled via raise_for_status().
UpdateNoteResponse.title: UpdateNoteResponse
